children: Goldman Sachs (GS) reported revenue $18.68B and EPS $17.01. Equities revenue jumped 72% to $6.44B from derivatives intermediation and financing. Investment banking backlog stays strong.
RBC kept Sector Perform on Goldman Sachs (GS), cut its price target to $1,010 from $1,220, raised 2026–27 EPS to $72.45 and $74.00, citing strong revenues, record management fees and AWM strength.
Goldman Sachs (GS) says client demand for AI infrastructure outstrips supply. Solomon estimates over $10 trillion in U.S. data center build-out through 2032 and flags Goldman as potential financer.
Goldman Sachs (GS) reports a hefty M&A backlog as clients pursue deals; CEO Solomon expects the deal window to stay open ~2.25 years and foresees ongoing transaction activity.
Goldman Sachs says U.S. IPO activity has slowed, IPO valuations are about 10–15% below prior expectations, and market volatility and higher rates are narrowing the IPO window for GS traders.
Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said there’s no succession plan or transition; board and management remain focused on growth and serving clients, countering media reports of leadership change.
Keefe Bruyette & Woods analyst Christopher McGratty kept a Market Perform on Goldman Sachs (GS) and cut his 12‑month price target to $1,100 from $1,130.
Goldman Sachs (GS) anchored Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO, subscribing ₹759.26 crore at ₹586/share (upper band) in a ₹2,534 crore offer for sale; proceeds go to selling shareholder.
Goldman Sachs bought 3,648,000 Tonbo Imaging India shares at ₹700 each, investing ~₹255.36 crore as an anchor in the ₹852 crore pre-IPO; the IPO is an offer-for-sale with no fresh proceeds.
